mutations.name: the sweep clears on a base with no required contexts
kills: the gone sweep on a main-ci-timeout gate keeps the gate when the base requires no context

mutations.name: a still-running main tip reads as green
mutations.find: if (mergeBaseSha !== main.mergeSha || judged.counted === 0 || judged.findings.length > 0) return undefined;
mutations.replace: if (mergeBaseSha !== main.mergeSha || judged.counted === 0 || judged.findings.some((finding) => finding.kind === "failed")) return undefined;
kills: the gone sweep on a main-ci-timeout gate keeps the gate while main is still running

mutations.name: a green tip that does not contain the merge clears the gate
mutations.find: if (mergeBaseSha !== main.mergeSha || judged.counted === 0 || judged.findings.length > 0) return undefined;
kills: the gone sweep on a main-ci-timeout gate keeps the gate when the green main commit does not contain the merge

mutations.name: the run fails on the sweep's main green cancel
kills: the gone sweep on a main-ci-timeout gate clears the gate once a later main commit containing the merge is green on every required context, and the run finishes

mutations.name: only the live sweep clears main-ci-timeout gates
kills: the gone sweep on a main-ci-timeout gate reports the clear on a dry run and cancels nothing
